CONSERVATIVE.title: Conservative
CONSERVATIVE.detail: Fewer false positives, but some identifiers may be missed.

AGGRESSIVE.title: Aggressive

AGGRESSIVE.detail: Misses the least, but expect more false positives to review.

logic.title: Configuration logic
logic.intro:
Methods are automatically selected based on {{law}} risk level.
You can review how each entity is processed below.
logic.specialNote:
These entity types are legally protected under {{article}}.
Only Remove is permitted. This cannot be overridden

PERSON.rationale: Assigns a consistent token, allows re-linking if legally required

ORGANIZATION.rationale: Hides part of the value if organisation is considered sensitive

DATE_TIME.rationale: Converts DOB to age range (e.g. 40–50). Timestamps rounded to month or quarter

LOCATION.rationale: Reduces to region or 3-digit postcode. EDPB recommends geographic generalisation

IP.rationale: Last segment of the IP address is removed. Only the network range is kept, making it impossible to identify the specific device or user.

GEOPOINT.rationale: Exact coordinates rounded to city or regional centroid

NATIONAL_ID.rationale: One-way removal. No plaintext mapping stored in dataset

CREDIT_CARD.rationale: Removes full numbers. BIN or last 4 digits may be kept only if business-necessary and documented.

EMAIL.rationale: Full address and number removed. Domain may be preserved if business-necessary

MEDICAL_RECORD_NUMBER.rationale: Stable token assigned. Mapping stored server-side under access control

DEVICE_ID.rationale: One-way encryption with salt. Keys stored under strict access control

FREE_TEXT.rationale: NLP model scans unstructured text. Manual QA recommended before sharing

BIOLOGICAL_DATA.rationale: Treated as highest-risk data. No alternative methods permitted
